quest.title: Lighthouse Letter
quest.description: A mysterious letter found on top of a lighthouse.

node.journal_entry: "I really didn't want to leave the wagon. I wanted to meet you there but as soon as the guards mysteriously disappeared, I knew I had to leave the bridge and get as far away as I could. This is the first place I run to. You remember this place? I remember you telling me about your people and how much misunderstood they are. I didn't really care. All I wanted was look into your eyes. Here you promised me that you'd take me to see your city and watch the ways of your people... Look for my next letter at the cave where you took me to see the Sadayel ritual. I remember we were hiding and that I was so afraid that they would catch us. You know the cave I'm talking about right? The one with the beautiful waters and the big tree inside."
